candidates.titulo: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
candidates.resumen: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.

candidates.titulo: LinkedIn actually adds a ‘seems like AI slop’ button
candidates.resumen:
